[SWS_EM_CONSTR_02559] Ability to restart
⌈
In the context of one
Machine
,
at least one
Process
shall have a
stateDependentStartupConfig
.
function-
GroupState
that has the
shortName Restart
.
⌋
Please note that multiple
Processes
with
State Management
responsibilities can
be deployed on a single
Machine
. However, to maintain a consistent state of a
Func-
tion Group
, it is crucial that a
Function Group
is managed by a single
State
Management Process
. If multiple
Processes
were managing a
Function Group
,
it would create ambiguity with regards to which
State Management Process
is fi-
nally responsible. This could potentially lead to an inconsistent state of a
Function
Group
.
